VERIFY list:
- SC-SPC-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-SPC-A-PASS — knowledge-test passing score not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-SPC-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-SPC-A-FRESH — possibly newer unlinked manual upload not compared (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- SC-SPC-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- SC-SPC-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the yearly work zone injury count (sec15-F12) and the national trailer towing mileage (sec15-R07) are statistics that change and must be refreshed before display.
